entities.summary: Daniel Andres Farquhar is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He played for the Toronto Blue Jays, Seattle Mariners, Tampa Bay Rays, and Chicago White Sox in Major League Baseball (MLB) from 2011 to 2018. He had a brain aneurysm during his final MLB game. Farquhar is the assistant pitching coach for the Mariners.
